summary.zh: 管理层察觉代表学校管理体系对地下组织异常活动的怀疑程度。察觉越高，校园越容易进入高压状态。
summary.en: Faculty Awareness represents how suspicious the school administration is of underground activity. Higher awareness makes high-pressure responses more likely.

items.zh: 管理层察觉显示学校管理体系对玩家组织的怀疑程度。
items.en: Faculty Awareness shows how suspicious the administration is of the player's organization.

items.zh: 察觉越高，巡逻、调查、封锁和检查越可能出现。
items.en: Higher awareness makes patrols, investigations, lockdowns, and inspections more likely.

items.zh: 察觉是玩家地下发展阶段最重要的风险指标之一。
items.en: Awareness is one of the most important risk metrics during underground development.

items.zh: 连续邀请、公开集会和高调宣传可能提高察觉。
items.en: Repeated invitations, public rallies, and loud propaganda may raise awareness.

items.zh: 管理层支持者发现异常时，察觉会更容易上升。
items.en: When faculty supporters notice suspicious activity, awareness can rise more easily.

items.zh: 贿赂错误对象也可能直接暴露组织。
items.en: Bribing the wrong target may directly expose the organization.

items.zh: 察觉较高时，应减少连续高调行动。
items.en: When awareness is high, reduce consecutive high-profile actions.

items.zh: 潜伏状态和侦查行动可以帮助玩家更谨慎地推进。
items.en: Hidden status and scouting actions can help the player advance more carefully.
